event_ledger_sample.description: Established HelixNova Biotech organizational and financial baseline including key roles and the $420,000 quarterly cloud GPU compute budget.
Project Proteus officially launched to build the generative antibody folding pipeline.
Selected Snowflake Enterprise as the primary assay analytics data warehouse.
Committed to In-House 14B Assay Foundation Model Training rather than licensing an external API.
Migrated off Snowflake Enterprise and switched to Self-Hosted ClickHouse for assay analytics data warehouse due to high per-query credit burn.
Reagent Batch HX-409 passed initial optical QC with 0.0% buffer contamination and was cleared for screening.
Follow-up LC-MS mass-spectrometry audit on Reagent Batch HX-409 contradicted the earlier 0.0% report, revealing 3.8% Tris-buffer cross-contamination and resulting in quarantine.
Project Proteus was cancelled on 2026-04-19 due to spot H100 cluster preemption rates exceeding 42% and stalling training runs.
Dr. Elena Vance was promoted from Principal Scientist to VP of Computational Biology.
Marcus Chen transitioned from Backend Lead to Clinical Data Security Lead.
Legacy cluster staging-us-west-1 permanently decommissioned and staging runs moved to staging-eu-central-2.
The board reduced HelixNova Biotech's quarterly cloud GPU compute budget from $420,000 to $240,000 per quarter.
Reversed the Self-Hosted ClickHouse decision and standardized the primary assay analytics data warehouse on PostgreSQL 16 + Parquet Lakehouse following a GxP audit trail review.
Project Proteus restarted as Project Proteus-Lite focused on CDR-H3 loop optimization using 16 reserved H200 GPUs via academic co-op credits.
